
# Ansible Code

- name: Install package for pathnex
  hosts: all
  become: yes
  
  tasks:
    - name: install tools
      yum:
        name:
          -git
           -wget
         state: present

# Terraform

provider "aws"{
  region= "us-east-1"
}
resource "aws_key_pair" "rizwankey"{

  key_name   = "rizwan-key"
  public_key = "ssh-rsa  email@example.com"
}

resource "aws_instance" "rizwan" {
  ami           = "ami-0abcd1234abcd1234"
  instance_type = "t3.small"
  key_name = aws_key_pair.rizwankey.key_name
  tags = {
    Name = "self"
  }
}



#Kubernetes — Create ClusterIP Service

apiVersion: v1
kind: service
metadata:
  name: rizwan-service
 spec:
   selector:
     app: rizwan-app
    port:
      - port: 80
        target: 80
